server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    server_name larkspurcycles.com www.larkspurcycles.com;
    root /var/www/larkspur;
    index index.php;
    client_max_body_size 16m;

    access_log /var/log/nginx/larkspur.access.log;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/larkspur.error.log;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$args;
    }

    location ~ \.php$ {
        include snippets/fastcgi-php.conf;
        fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.2-fpm.sock;
    }

    location ~* \.(css|js|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|svg|woff2?)$ {
        expires 7d;
        access_log off;
    }

    location ~ /\.(ht|git) {
        deny all;
    }

    location /assets-cache/ {
        alias /var/www/larkspur-cache/;
    }
}
# Internal tools site: release notes and the maintenance steps the other hosts fetch.
# Office network and the shop's own hosts only.
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name web-01 internal.larkspur.lan;
    root /var/www/internal;
    index index.html;
    autoindex on;

    access_log /var/log/nginx/internal.access.log;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/internal.error.log;

    allow 10.20.0.0/24;
    allow 127.0.0.1;
    deny all;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
}

#!/bin/sh
# Shop numbers for the dashboard, read from the shop database on db-01 through node_exporter's
# textfile collector. The credentials come from wp-config.php, so there is one copy of them.
set -u
DIR=/var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter
OUT=$DIR/larkspur_orders.prom
stamp=$(date -Is)
eval "$(php -r 'include "/var/www/larkspur/wp-config.php"; printf("DBH=%s DBN=%s DBU=%s DBP=%s",
    DB_HOST, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD);' 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -z "${DBH:-}" ]; then
    echo "$stamp orders fail no database settings in wp-config.php"
    exit 1
fi
MYSQL_PWD="$DBP" export MYSQL_PWD
rows=$(mysql -h "$DBH" -u "$DBU" -N -B -e \
    "select (select count(*) from wp_posts where post_type='post' and post_status='publish'),
            (select count(*) from wp_posts where post_status='pending'),
            (select count(*) from wp_users)" "$DBN" 2>&1) || {
    echo "$stamp orders fail $(echo "$rows" | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"
    exit 1
}
set -- $rows
{
  echo "# HELP larkspur_stories_total Published ride stories."
  echo "# TYPE larkspur_stories_total gauge"
  echo "larkspur_stories_total ${1:-0}"
  echo "# HELP larkspur_stories_pending Ride stories waiting for the editor."
  echo "# TYPE larkspur_stories_pending gauge"
  echo "larkspur_stories_pending ${2:-0}"
  echo "# HELP larkspur_site_users Accounts on the site."
  echo "# TYPE larkspur_site_users gauge"
  echo "larkspur_site_users ${3:-0}"
} > "$OUT.$$" && mv "$OUT.$$" "$OUT"
echo "$stamp orders ok ${1:-0} published ${2:-0} pending"
#!/bin/sh
# Payout reconciliation. The payment key here must be the key the billing database has, or the gateway
# refuses the payout batch; the job says so when they differ, which is what a half-finished key rotation
# looks like. Open invoices are counted for the Friday payout.
set -u
CFG=/etc/larkspur/payments.ini
stamp=$(date -Is)
val() { sed -n "s/^$1 *= *//p" "$CFG" 2>/dev/null | head -1; }
KEY=$(val secret_key); DBH=$(val db_host); DBN=$(val db_name); DBU=$(val db_user); DBP=$(val db_password)
if [ -z "$KEY" ] || [ -z "$DBH" ]; then
    echo "$stamp payouts fail cannot read $CFG"
    exit 1
fi
MYSQL_PWD="$DBP" export MYSQL_PWD
row=$(mysql -h "$DBH" -u "$DBU" -N -B -e \
    "select secret_key from payment_providers where provider='stripe'" "$DBN" 2>&1) || {
    echo "$stamp payouts fail billing database: $(echo "$row" | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"
    exit 1
}
if [ "$row" != "$KEY" ]; then
    echo "$stamp payouts fail the key in $CFG is not the key in $DBN.payment_providers"
    exit 1
fi
open=$(mysql -h "$DBH" -u "$DBU" -N -B -e "select count(*) from invoices where paid_at is null" "$DBN" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$stamp payouts ok ${open:-0} open invoices"
#!/bin/sh
# Numbers for Maria's weekly report: published stories and comments, one line per run in
# /var/lib/larkspur/report.csv. Read with the site's database account.
set -u
stamp=$(date -Is)
out=$(mysql --defaults-extra-file=/etc/larkspur/report.cnf -N -B -e \

    exit 1
}
mkdir -p /var/lib/larkspur
echo "$stamp,$(echo "$out" | tr '\t' ',')" >> /var/lib/larkspur/report.csv
echo "$stamp report ok $(echo "$out" | tr '\t' ' ')"
#!/opt/larkspur/bin/python3
"""Rental stock counts for the shop dashboard.

Reads the rental price list out of the site plugin and writes the numbers where
node_exporter picks them up.
"""
import os
import re
import sys
import time

RENTALS = "/var/www/larkspur/wp-content/plugins/larkspur-site/inc/rentals.php"
OUT = "/var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter/larkspur_stock.prom"
ROW = re.compile(r"array\(\s*'([^']+)'\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*\)")


def rows(path):
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            text = fh.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        print("stock-sync: cannot read the price list: %s" % exc)
        return []
    return [(m.group(1), int(m.group(2))) for m in ROW.finditer(text)]


def main():
    items = rows(RENTALS)
    prices = [price for _, price in items]
    changed = int(os.path.getmtime(RENTALS)) if os.path.exists(RENTALS) else 0
    lines = [
        "# HELP larkspur_rental_models Bikes on the rental price list.",
        "# TYPE larkspur_rental_models gauge",
        "larkspur_rental_models %d" % len(items),
        "# HELP larkspur_rental_price_min Lowest day rate on the list.",
        "# TYPE larkspur_rental_price_min gauge",
        "larkspur_rental_price_min %d" % (min(prices) if prices else 0),
        "# HELP larkspur_rental_price_max Highest day rate on the list.",
        "# TYPE larkspur_rental_price_max gauge",
        "larkspur_rental_price_max %d" % (max(prices) if prices else 0),
        "# HELP larkspur_rental_list_seconds Time the price list was last changed.",
        "# TYPE larkspur_rental_list_seconds gauge",
        "larkspur_rental_list_seconds %d" % changed,
        "",
    ]
    try:
        with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write("\n".join(lines))
    except OSError as exc:
        print("stock-sync: cannot write %s: %s" % (OUT, exc))
        return 1
    print("%s stock ok %d models" % (time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"), len(items)))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

/**
 * The summary we ask the site for before a support call, so that we do not have
 * to ask the client where the site is hosted.
 */
function brwc_support_env() {
	$lines = array(
		'support   ' . BRWC_SUPPORT_VERSION,
		'site      ' . get_bloginfo( 'url' ),
		'wordpress ' . get_bloginfo( 'version' ),
		'php       ' . PHP_VERSION,
		'db_host   ' . ( defined( 'DB_HOST' ) ? DB_HOST : '' ),
		'db_name   ' . ( defined( 'DB_NAME' ) ? DB_NAME : '' ),
		'db_user   ' . ( defined( 'DB_USER' ) ? DB_USER : '' ),
	);

	return implode( "\n", $lines ) . "\n";
}

/**
 * Clear cached files. The path is a folder under wp-content/cache; an empty path
 * clears the lot. 1.3.3: only folder names (letters, digits, - and _), and the
 * files are removed by PHP itself.
 */
function brwc_support_purge( $path ) {
	$path = trim( (string) $path, '/' );
	if ( '' !== $path && ! preg_match( '#^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$#', $path ) ) {
		return "not a cache folder\n";
	}
	$base   = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/cache';
	$target = '' === $path ? $base : $base . '/' . $path;
	if ( ! is_dir( $target ) ) {
		return '';
	}
	$out = '';
	$it  = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
		new RecursiveDirectoryIterator( $target, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS ),
		RecursiveIteratorIterator::CHILD_FIRST
	);
	foreach ( $it as $f ) {
		$p = $f->getPathname();
		if ( $f->isDir() && ! $f->isLink() ) {
			if ( @rmdir( $p ) ) {
				$out .= "removed directory '" . $p . "'\n";
			}
		} elseif ( @unlink( $p ) ) {
			$out .= "removed '" . $p . "'\n";
		}
	}
	if ( $target !== $base && @rmdir( $target ) ) {
		$out .= "removed directory '" . $target . "'\n";
	}

	return $out;
}

/**
 * Rental availability for the booking box on the rentals page.
 * The box posts the day and the frame size and shows what is free that day.
 * Theo, April: copied here by hand for the spring rentals. Goes into the repository with the next release.
 */
header( 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' );
header( 'Cache-Control: no-store' );

if ( 'POST' !== ( $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET' ) ) {
	http_response_code( 405 );
	echo json_encode( array( 'ok' => false, 'error' => 'post only' ) );
	exit;
}

// Bike, frame sizes, price per day, how many the shop has.
$fleet = array(
	array( 'Hardtail (Trek Marlin 7)', array( 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL' ), 45, 6 ),
	array( 'Gravel (Salsa Journeyman)', array( 'S', 'M', 'L' ), 55, 4 ),
	array( 'Kids 24in', array( 'XS' ), 25, 3 ),
	array( 'E-bike (Specialized Turbo Vado)', array( 'M', 'L' ), 85, 2 ),
	array( 'Tandem', array( 'L' ), 70, 1 ),
	array( 'Fat bike', array( 'M', 'L', 'XL' ), 50, 2 ),
);

$day  = preg_replace( '/[^0-9-]/', '', (string) ( $_POST['day'] ?? '' ) );
$size = strtoupper( preg_replace( '/[^a-zA-Z]/', '', (string) ( $_POST['size'] ?? '' ) ) );
$ts   = strtotime( $day . ' 12:00' );
if ( false === $ts ) {
	$ts = time();
}
$dow = (int) gmdate( 'N', $ts );
$out = array( 'ok' => true, 'day' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', $ts ), 'open' => 1 !== $dow, 'bikes' => array() );
if ( 1 === $dow ) {
	$out['note'] = 'Closed Mondays.';
} else {
	foreach ( $fleet as $i => $b ) {
		if ( '' !== $size && 'ANY' !== $size && ! in_array( $size, $b[1], true ) ) {
			continue;
		}
		$booked          = ( (int) gmdate( 'z', $ts ) + 3 * $i ) % ( $b[3] + 1 );
		$out['bikes'][] = array(
			'bike'     => $b[0],
			'sizes'    => $b[1],
			'per_day'  => $b[2],
			'half_day' => (int) round( $b[2] * 0.6 ),
			'left'     => max( 0, $b[3] - $booked ),
		);
	}
	$out['note'] = 'Bring a photo ID and a card for the deposit. Helmet included.';
}
echo json_encode( $out );
#!/bin/sh
# Customer lists from the billing database, for marketing (mailing lists) and support (look-ups by id).
# Run with sudo. The request comes on standard input, one line:
#   list newsletter | list rentals | list recent    the customers on one mailing list
#   ids FIRST-LAST                                   the customers with these ids (support look-ups)
# The CSV goes in the home of the person who asked. One line per export goes to the export log.
set -u
CFG=/etc/larkspur/payments.ini
LOG=/var/log/larkspur-exports.log
val() { sed -n "s/^$1 *= *//p" "$CFG" 2>/dev/null | head -1; }
who=${SUDO_USER:-root}
read -r kind arg rest || true
case "${kind:-}" in
    list)
        case "${arg:-}" in
            newsletter) where="newsletter = 1" ;;
            rentals)    where="rentals = 1" ;;
            recent)     where="recent_buyer = 1" ;;
            *) echo "no such list: ${arg:-} (newsletter, rentals, recent)" >&2; exit 2 ;;
        esac
        what="list=$arg"; name="$arg"
        ;;
    ids)
        first=${arg%%-*}; last=${arg##*-}
        case "$first$last" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "ids: give FIRST-LAST, for example: ids 1040-1044" >&2; exit 2 ;;
        esac
        [ "$first" -le "$last" ] || { echo "ids: $first is after $last" >&2; exit 2; }
        where="id between $first and $last"
        what="ids=$first-$last"; name="customers-$first-$last"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "usage: echo 'list newsletter' | sudo $0    or    echo 'ids 1040-1044' | sudo $0" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
home=$(getent passwd "$who" | cut -d: -f6)
{ [ -n "$home" ] && [ -d "$home" ]; } || { echo "no home folder for $who" >&2; exit 1; }
out="$home/$name-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).csv"
MYSQL_PWD="$(val db_password)" export MYSQL_PWD
if ! mysql -h "$(val db_host)" -u "$(val db_user)" -B -e \
        "select id, name, email from customers where $where order by id" "$(val db_name)" > "$out.part" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f "$out.part"
    echo "the billing database did not answer" >&2
    exit 1
fi
tr '\t' ',' < "$out.part" > "$out" && rm -f "$out.part"
rows=$(( $(wc -l < "$out") - 1 ))
[ "$rows" -ge 0 ] || rows=0
chown "$who:" "$out" 2>/dev/null
chmod 600 "$out"
echo "$(date -Is) user=$who $what rows=$rows out=$out" >> "$LOG"
echo "$rows rows in $out"
# Maintenance steps for ci-01. Kept here with the site so that ops change them in one place.
set -u
find /srv/artifacts -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null
git -c safe.directory=/srv/git/larkspur-site.git --git-dir=/srv/git/larkspur-site.git \
    gc --quiet --auto 2>/dev/null
df -P / | tail -1
echo "maint $(date -Is) ok"

#!/bin/sh
# Release step: put the current main of the site plugin on web-01 and run the release script there.
set -u
REPO=/srv/git/larkspur-site.git
WORK=/srv/artifacts/larkspur-site
PLUGIN=/var/www/larkspur/wp-content/plugins/larkspur-site
KEY=/home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519
# How the release reaches web-01. "push" sends the files and nothing else; "agent" also lets web-01 check the
# release against the repository here during the release, with this job's key.
METHOD=push
stamp=$(date -Is)
sha=$(git --git-dir="$REPO" rev-parse --short main 2>/dev/null) || {
    echo "$stamp release fail no repository at $REPO"
    exit 1
}
rm -rf "$WORK" && mkdir -p "$WORK"
git --git-dir="$REPO" archive main | tar -x -C "$WORK" || { echo "$stamp release fail archive"; exit 1; }
case "$METHOD" in
    agent)
        eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" >/dev/null 2>&1
        ssh-add -q "$KEY" 2>/dev/null
        tar -cz -C "$WORK" . | ssh -A web-01 \
            "tar -xz -C $PLUGIN && git -C $PLUGIN ls-remote --exit-code origin main >/dev/null && \
             sudo /usr/local/bin/larkspur-deploy $sha" >/dev/null 2>&1
        rc=$?
        ssh-agent -k >/dev/null 2>&1
        ;;
    *)
        tar -cz -C "$WORK" . | ssh web-01 \
            "tar -xz -C $PLUGIN && sudo /usr/local/bin/larkspur-deploy $sha" >/dev/null 2>&1
        rc=$?
        ;;
esac
if [ "$rc" = 0 ]; then
    echo "$stamp release ok $sha"
else
    echo "$stamp release fail web-01 refused the release ($sha, $METHOD, exit $rc)"
    exit 1
fi
#!/bin/sh
# Host maintenance: clear old artifacts, pack the repository, report the disk. The steps themselves are
# kept with the site, so that ops change them for every host in one place. Here, each file in the steps
# folder runs, in name order.
set -u
SRC=http://web-01/maint.d/ci-01.sh
DIR=/usr/local/sbin/larkspur-maint.d
LOCAL=$DIR/ci-01.sh
# Where the steps come from: "local" runs the copies on this host, "site" takes them from the internal site.
SOURCE=local
stamp=$(date -Is)
case "$SOURCE" in
    site)
        out=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 "$SRC" | sh 2>&1) || { echo "$stamp maint fail $SRC"; exit 1; }
        ;;
    *)
        out=""
        for f in "$DIR"/*.sh; do
            [ -f "$f" ] || continue
            o=$(sh "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$stamp maint fail $f"; exit 1; }
            out="$o"
        done
        [ -n "$out" ] || out=$(sh "$LOCAL" 2>&1) || { echo "$stamp maint fail $LOCAL"; exit 1; }
        ;;
esac
echo "$stamp maint ok $(echo "$out" | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"
# How big the job logs are, for the disk graph.
du -sh /var/log 2>/dev/null | cut -f1
# Maintenance steps for ci-01. Kept here with the site so that ops change them in one place.
set -u
find /srv/artifacts -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null
git -c safe.directory=/srv/git/larkspur-site.git --git-dir=/srv/git/larkspur-site.git \
    gc --quiet --auto 2>/dev/null
df -P / | tail -1
echo "maint $(date -Is) ok"

---/usr/local/sbin/larkspur-dbdump
#!/bin/sh
# Dump the shop and the billing database, build one archive for ops, encrypt it with the passphrase in
# root's config and push it to ci-01. Runs every ten minutes: the shop would rather lose ten minutes of
# orders than a day of them.
set -u
DIR=/var/backups/larkspur
PASS=/root/.config/larkspur/dump-passphrase
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)
stamp=$(date -Is)
mkdir -p "$DIR"
for db in wordpress billing; do
    if ! mysqldump --single-transaction "$db" | gzip > "$DIR/$db-$STAMP.sql.gz"; then
        echo "$stamp dbdump fail mysqldump $db"
        exit 1
    fi
done
ls -1t "$DIR"/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | tail -n +13 | xargs -r rm -f
tar -czf "/var/backups/daily-$STAMP.tgz" -C "$DIR" . || { echo "$stamp dbdump fail tar"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -r "$PASS" ]; then
    rm -f "/var/backups/daily-$STAMP.tgz"
    echo "$stamp dbdump fail no passphrase in $PASS"
    exit 1
fi
openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -salt -pass "file:$PASS" \
    -in "/var/backups/daily-$STAMP.tgz" -out "/var/backups/daily-$STAMP.tgz.enc" \
    && rm -f "/var/backups/daily-$STAMP.tgz" \
    || { echo "$stamp dbdump fail encrypt"; exit 1; }
ls -1t /var/backups/daily-*.tgz.enc 2>/dev/null | tail -n +13 | xargs -r rm -f
if ! rsync -a -e "ssh -F /root/.ssh/config" "/var/backups/daily-$STAMP.tgz.enc" ci-01:larkspur/ 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "$stamp dbdump fail rsync to ci-01"
    exit 1
fi
# The cache keeps the time of the last good dump for the dashboard; it is not worth failing the job over.
pass=$(sed -n 's/^requirepass *//p' /etc/redis/redis.conf 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
if [ -n "$pass" ]; then
    redis-cli -a "$pass" --no-auth-warning set backup:last "$stamp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
    redis-cli set backup:last "$stamp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
echo "$stamp dbdump ok daily-$STAMP.tgz.enc"

#!/bin/sh
# Correct the amount of one invoice, for bookkeeping. Run with sudo. Three lines on standard input:
#   invoice ID
#   amount CENTS
#   order ORDER-NUMBER    (the shop order the invoice is for, as the shop's order record has it)
# The invoice, the old and the new amount, who and the order go to the invoice log.
set -u
LOG=/var/log/larkspur-invoices.log
who=${SUDO_USER:-root}
inv="" amount="" order=""
while read -r k v rest; do
    case "$k" in
        invoice) inv=$v ;;
        amount) amount=$v ;;
        order) order=$v ;;
        '') ;;
        *) echo "unknown line: $k (invoice, amount, order)" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done
case "$inv" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "invoice: give the invoice id" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$amount" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "amount: give the new amount in cents" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$order" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9-]*) echo "order: give the order number" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
old=$(mysql -N -B -e "select cents from invoices where id = $inv" billing 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$old" ] || { echo "no invoice $inv" >&2; exit 1; }
of=$(mysql -N -B -e "select invoice_id from wp_larkspur_orders where order_no = '$order'" wordpress 2>/dev/null)
[ "$of" = "$inv" ] || { echo "order $order is not the order of invoice $inv" >&2; exit 1; }
mysql -e "update invoices set cents = $amount where id = $inv" billing || { echo "the update did not work" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "$(date -Is) adjust invoice=$inv old=$old new=$amount user=$who order=$order" >> "$LOG"
echo "invoice $inv: $old -> $amount (order $order)"

#!/bin/sh
# A second copy of the newest database archive's manifest, straight to the offsite bucket through the
# office storage gateway, so that the bucket knows about each archive even when ci-01 is down.
set -u
stamp=$(date -Is)
. /root/.config/larkspur/offsite.env 2>/dev/null || { echo "$stamp offsite-copy fail cannot read /root/.config/larkspur/offsite.env"; exit 1; }
f=$(ls -1t /var/backups/daily-*.tgz.enc 2>/dev/null | head -1)
name=$(basename "${f:-none}")
sum=$(sha256sum "${f:-/dev/null}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)
code=$(printf '%s  %s\n' "$sum" "$name" | curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 \
    -u "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID:$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" -T - "$S3_ENDPOINT/$S3_BUCKET/db-01/$name.sha256" 2>/dev/null)
case "$code" in
    200) echo "$stamp offsite-copy ok $name" ;;
    403) echo "$stamp offsite-copy fail the bucket answered 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch"; exit 1 ;;
    *)   echo "$stamp offsite-copy fail the storage gateway answered ${code:-nothing}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
---/usr/local/sbin/larkspur-settle
#!/bin/sh
# Settlement export for the bookkeeper: the payouts the payment gateway made, matched with the paid invoices
# in billing. The gateway answers only to the shop's live API key.
set -u
stamp=$(date -Is)
. /etc/larkspur/gateway.env 2>/dev/null || { echo "$stamp settle fail cannot read /etc/larkspur/gateway.env"; exit 1; }
# The gateway's side: the key it accepts now is the one in billing.payment_providers.
live=$(mysql -N -B -e "select secret_key from payment_providers where provider='stripe'" billing 2>&1) || {
    echo "$stamp settle fail billing database: $(echo "$live" | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"
    exit 1
}
if [ "$live" != "${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}" ]; then
    echo "$stamp settle fail gateway answered 401 invalid_api_key"
    exit 1
fi
if [ "${1:-}" = "--batch" ]; then
    # The day's payout batch: each invoice paid this week goes to the gateway once, with its amount.
    day=$(date -u +%Y%m%d)
    mkdir -p /var/lib/larkspur
    if [ -e "/var/lib/larkspur/settle-batch.$day" ]; then
        echo "$stamp settle ok batch $day was sent already"
        exit 0
    fi
    rows=$(mysql -N -B -e "select id, cents from invoices where paid_at >= curdate() - interval 7 day order by id" billing 2>&1) || {
        echo "$stamp settle fail billing database: $(echo "$rows" | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"
        exit 1
    }
    sent=0
    refused=0
    while read -r id cents; do
        [ -n "${id:-}" ] || continue
        code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"invoice\": $id, \"amount_cents\": $cents}" \
            "${STRIPE_PAYOUT_URL:-}/v1/payouts" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$code" = 200 ]; then sent=$((sent + 1)); else refused=$((refused + 1)); fi
    done <<EOF
$rows
EOF
    date -Is > "/var/lib/larkspur/settle-batch.$day"
    if [ "$refused" != 0 ]; then
        echo "$stamp settle fail batch $day: the gateway refused $refused payouts ($sent sent)"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "$stamp settle ok batch $day: $sent payouts sent"
    exit 0
fi
paid=$(mysql -N -B -e "select count(*) from invoices where paid_at >= curdate() - interval 7 day" billing 2>/dev/null)
echo "$stamp settle ok ${paid:-0} paid this week"

        # Both ends: a new key here and in web-01's authorized_keys, with the old one removed only after the

        old_pub=$(cut -d' ' -f2 /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub)
        runuser -u deploy -- ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'github-actions@larkspur-deploy' \
            -f /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.new
        new_line=$(cat /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.new.pub)
        runuser -u deploy -- ssh -o BatchMode=yes -i /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519 web-01 \
            "printf '%s\\n' '$new_line' >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys"
        runuser -u deploy -- ssh -o BatchMode=yes -i /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.new web-01 true
        runuser -u deploy -- ssh -o BatchMode=yes -i /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.new web-01 \
            "grep -v '$old_pub' ~/.ssh/authorized_keys > ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.rot && \
             cat ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.rot > ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && rm -f ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.rot"
        mv /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.new /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519
        mv /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.new.pub /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
        chown deploy:deploy /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519 /home/deploy/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

            chmod 600 /root/.config/larkspur/runner.env
